void display() {
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
  float A[8], B[8], C[8];
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -5.5000f);
  glRotatef(18.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(32.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- source ---
  glClearColor(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT3);
  glBegin(GL_QUADS);
    if(sin(t) > 0) {
      glColor3f(1, 0.2, 0.2);
    }
    if(sin(t) <= 0) {
      glColor3f(0.2, 0.2, 1);
    }
    glNormal3f(0, 0, 1);
    glVertex3f(-1, -1, 0);
    glVertex3f(1, -1, 0);
    glVertex3f(1, 1, 0);
    glVertex3f(-1, 1, 0);
    if(cos(t) > 0) {
      glColor3f(0.2, 1, 0.2);
    }
    if(cos(t) <= 0) {
      glColor3f(1, 1, 0.2);
    }
    glNormal3f(0, 0, -1);
    glVertex3f(-1, -1, -1);
    glVertex3f(-1, 1, -1);
    glVertex3f(1, 1, -1);
    glVertex3f(1, -1, -1);
  glEnd();
